name: Anime Recommendation System
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: This is an Anime Recommendation System that combines multiple recommendation techniques such as Collaborative Filtering, Content-Based Filtering, and Popularity-Based Filtering. We used the AnimeList 2023 dataset, but to optimize computational cost and storage, we included only animes with an average rating above 6.0. The system is designed for continuous data ingestion and transformation and is fully dockerized for seamless deployment.

The system is hosted on Hugging Face Spaces and fetches datasets and pre-trained models from Hugging Face Hub to generate personalized anime recommendations based on user preferences and anime features.
